author: Gamers Nexus
description:
GRAB THE DISCS ON THE STORE! They will begin shipping by December 1. https://store.gamersnexus.net/
We're going back to the physical media age as an educational exercise to learn how discs used to be duplicated for small-scale productions, how they're printed on with thermal printers, and the software needed for encoding and chaptering. As a one-year anniversary of getting Bloomberged for our AI GPU Black Market documentary, this multi-part series brings us some safety from the one-click copyright strike takedowns and YouTube compression as we research how to launch in-house burned Blu-Ray discs, audio CDs, and more. Features a Cronus automated disc duplicator that we bought.

Get our Blu-Ray version of factory tours, educational videos, engineering interviews, and special reports here: https://store.gamersnexus.net/products/gn-factory-tours-and-special-reports-blu-ray-discs-4k-case
And our Blu-Ray version of the AI GPU Black Market here: https://store.gamersnexus.net/products/blu-ray
title: F You, Sony | Bringing Back Discs & Learning a Lost Art, Pt. 1
